reason: Carving planks seems like a direct way to make the printing block needed for the press.
expectation: I expect a carved printing block, though it may need further preparation.

alternatives.reason: Charcoal and water might make ink, but I chose to make the block first.

effect: The carved printing block is ready; it can now be combined with iron.
reaction: The result was straightforward and matched my expectation.
reason: Combining the block with iron seems likely to advance construction of the press.
expectation: I expect a printing press or a component for one, though the iron's exact role is unclear.

alternatives.reason: Charcoal and water may make ink, but I want to build the press first.

effect: The press is built, and the new goal is to print a page; it needs an inked block and paper.
reaction: The explanation of the screw and plate made the press mechanism clear.
reason: Charcoal and water may make the ink needed for printing.
expectation: I expect ink or a mixture that can be used as ink.

alternatives.reason: Paper must go at the press, but I want to prepare the likely ink first.

effect: Ink is ready for printing, as expected.
reason: Place the ink at the press to prepare for printing.
expectation: I expect the ink to be available at the press for the next printing step.

alternatives.reason: Paper is also needed, but I chose to place the ink first.

effect: Ink is at the press, and paper can now be combined with it there.
reason: Combine the paper and ink at the press to work toward the printed page.
expectation: I expect a printed page, though another step may be needed.

effect: The press produced printed pages and completed the chapter; the prints need to dry before hanging.
reaction: Seeing the same illustration repeated makes the purpose of the press tangible.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the press was most worthwhile because its description explained how the screw and plate transfer the image to paper.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the ink felt like a routine preparation step.

surprise.text: Combining the block with iron produced a complete press, and the explanation clarified the iron screw's role.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the offered combinations followed the stated printing goal.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter to see what the settlement builds next, especially if it explains another mechanism as clearly as the press.
